name: io.github.nickzitzer/happy-platform-mcp
description: ServiceNow MCP server: 60 tools for any table, multi-instance, natural language search

environmentVariables.description: ServiceNow instance URL (e.g., https://dev123456.service-now.com)
environmentVariables.name: SERVICENOW_INSTANCE_URL

environmentVariables.description: ServiceNow username
environmentVariables.name: SERVICENOW_USERNAME

environmentVariables.description: ServiceNow password
environmentVariables.name: SERVICENOW_PASSWORD

environmentVariables.description: Authentication type (default: basic)
environmentVariables.name: SERVICENOW_AUTH_TYPE

environmentVariables.description: Specific instance name from config file (optional)
environmentVariables.name: SERVICENOW_INSTANCE

environmentVariables.description: Start with only ServiceNowDocs tools. Use true for docs-only deployments without ServiceNow credentials.
environmentVariables.name: HAPPY_MCP_DOCS_ONLY

environmentVariables.description: Enable optional local SQLite FTS indexing for ServiceNowDocs search
environmentVariables.name: HAPPY_DOCS_ENABLE_LOCAL_INDEX

environmentVariables.description: Directory for cached ServiceNowDocs markdown and SQLite index
environmentVariables.name: HAPPY_DOCS_CACHE_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Enable optional ServiceNowDocs vector search when local indexing, sqlite-vec, and an embedding provider are available.
environmentVariables.name: HAPPY_DOCS_ENABLE_VECTOR

environmentVariables.description: Embedding provider for ServiceNowDocs vector search. Use local for deterministic local embeddings or none to disable embeddings.
environmentVariables.name: HAPPY_DOCS_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER

environmentVariables.description: OAuth client ID (when SERVICENOW_AUTH_TYPE=oauth)
environmentVariables.name: SERVICENOW_CLIENT_ID

environmentVariables.description: OAuth client secret (when SERVICENOW_AUTH_TYPE=oauth)
environmentVariables.name: SERVICENOW_CLIENT_SECRET

environmentVariables.description: OAuth grant type (when SERVICENOW_AUTH_TYPE=oauth); passwordless grants do not need SERVICENOW_USERNAME/SERVICENOW_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.name: SERVICENOW_OAUTH_GRANT_TYPE

environmentVariables.description: Path to an instances.json multi-instance config file (optional)
environmentVariables.name: HAPPY_CONFIG_PATH
